title: Pre-Owned Homepage Redesign
subtitle: Restructuring a long, difficult-to-scan homepage into a clearer marketplace experience.

quickView.problem: Important shopping paths were hidden inside a long homepage with repeated content and weak hierarchy.
quickView.evolution: Research and analytics → information restructure → interactive prototype → December 2024 launch → Contentstack migration
quickView.product: A shorter homepage with clearer categories, stronger shopping paths, more visible trust content, and merchant-managed modules.
quickView.impact: Compared with a similar off-season period, the redesigned homepage had a 33.9% lower bounce rate, 28.2% lower exit rate, and 9.98% more time spent.
quickView.learning: Page structure can change behavior when research, business priorities, implementation, and measurement stay connected.
